definitions.explanation: The dominant or most widely accepted current of thought, practice, or culture. Can also refer literally to the main current of a river.

examples.japanese: ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{主流|しゅりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧つつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Online classes are becoming the mainstream.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手書|てが}き→手書き：08301_tegaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{主流|しゅりゅう}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Handwriting used to be the norm, but now almost everything is done on a computer.

notes:
{主流|しゅりゅう} literally means "main stream" (of a river) but is overwhelmingly used figuratively to mean the dominant trend, prevailing practice, or mainstream.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主流|しゅりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become mainstream
- {主流|しゅりゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧: to deviate from the mainstream
- {主流|しゅりゅう}{派|は}: mainstream faction
- {主流|しゅりゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}める→占める：11799_shimeru⟧: to dominate the mainstream

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {主流|しゅりゅう}: mainstream (dominant trend)
- メインストリーム: mainstream (loanword, less common)
- {傍流|ぼうりゅう}: offshoot, minor stream (opposite)
- ⟦{本流|ほんりゅう}→本流：25798_honryuu⟧: main current (more literal, river/lineage)

USAGE:
Often used to describe shifting trends: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{主流|しゅりゅう}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧B⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{主流|しゅりゅう}だ (A used to be mainstream, but now B is).
